name: power-app-dataverse-codex-plugin
description: Enterprise guidance skills and OAuth MCP tools for Dataverse and Power Platform AI action workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Design and run governed Dataverse AI action workflows with OAuth MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for shaping Dataverse and Power Apps into an autonomous enterprise intelligence platform. It includes Dataverse and Power Platform AI action design skills, advanced enterprise USP strategy, production and marketing documentation, and a real stdio MCP server for Microsoft Dataverse Web API access through OAuth2 client credentials. Write tools are gated by DATAVERSE_ALLOW_WRITES=true and explicit per-call confirmation.
capabilities: Live Dataverse MCP tools with OAuth
defaultPrompt: Design a Dataverse AI action workflow.
Review this Power Apps solution for ALM readiness.
Assess governance risks for this Dataverse action.
